messages:
maria: Quick idea — add a lightweight 'compare routes/models' quicklink in Console Analytics so PMs and SREs can see per-route latency/cost/err rate side-by-side. thinking small: 2-3 columns, persistent link you can paste into PRs. any blockers?
jamal: Love this. Main ask: does 'quicklink' create saved queries? we should avoid exploding saved-query lists for users.
oliver: API note — if we do persistent links we probably need a minimal saved-query model (id, scope, filters) vs full saved query with metadata. scope could be {route, team, org, private}.
priya: Also consider telemetry cost — if quicklinks auto-refresh for live compare that hits telemetry backend hard. maybe cached snapshot + manual refresh?
maria: yep — proposal: quicklink = URL with compact descriptor + optional server-side snapshot id. default snapshot = 5m cache, manual refresh button.
jamal: UX question: where does it live? route inspector? a floating compare button on route list? I worry about discoverability.
oliver: I'd put it in both places: route list row -> "compare" (select another route/model) and route detail -> "compare with...". clicking composes a compact URL and optionally saves to "My quicklinks".
priya: Quotas: saved snapshots should count against analytics quota. we can add a lightweight quota tier: free users get 5 snapshots/day, enterprise unlimited. Also throttle auto-refresh to 1/min per user.
maria: sounds reasonable. any objections to defaulting scope to 'private' unless explicitly shared? Avoids clutter.
jamal: agree. Also add owner + lastUsed metadata so we can surface stale quicklinks in UI and cleanup.
oliver: API sketch (very small):
```json
POST /api/analytics/quicklinks
{
  "filters": {"route_ids": ["r-123","r-456"], "model_ids": ["m-45"]},
  "view": "latency,cost,error_rate",
  "scope": "private", // private|team|org
  "ttl": 300 // seconds for cached snapshot
}
```
jamal: +1. For sharing we need a short-id in URL, not full JSON. security: validate access on fetch.
priya: telemetry impl: we can reuse the existing explorer snapshot pipeline. minor change: accept 'quicklink' as a source and surface billing attribution. also emit event: analytics.quicklink.view for experiments.
console-bot: Deployed analytics-explorer improvements to staging at 2026-02-14T12:02:31Z — snapshot API v2 available.
maria: ok next steps: oliver to prototype the minimal quicklink API + client, jamal to wire a compact UI affordance, priya to add quota cost + telemetry events. i'll draft a tiny product doc and mockups (figma) and post here by EOD.
jamal: i'll mock the row-level CTA and route compare modal.
oliver: i'll spin up a postman collection for the API and share example responses.
priya: tagging infra: @sre-team — we'll need to budget snapshot compute if this gets heavy.
maria: thanks all — if no major objections i'll put this on the roadmap for the Console Q2 sprint. :thumbsup:
jamal: :thumbsup:
priya: fine by me
oliver: go for it
